result.instructions: UNSAID returns places to eat and drink that fit a person's taste and that no major AI assistant names for that city. Call unsaid_places when a user wants recommendations that are personal and not the usual list. Every pick is a Qloo entity ranked by Qloo; do not suggest other places to eat or drink. You may name places from `wall.top_names` as what every assistant tells everyone.

tools.description: Given three things a person loves (any mix of music, film, TV, books, brands, a place, or a dish/cuisine/vibe) and a city, UNSAID asks ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini where to eat and drink there, crosses out every place they name (matched to Qloo IDs), and has Qloo rank what is left for those loves. Returns up to 7 picks, each with its Qloo id, '#k for you' (rank among the same N places with the person's taste) and '#j for anyone' (rank among the same N with no taste signal), whether it holds if any one love is dropped, the love that drives it, and how many AI answers named it (always 0). Also returns the wall: how many distinct places the AIs named and the most-named ones. Use it for 'not the usual list' asks. For where to eat and drink, use only these picks, in the order given; keep your own non-venue color (neighbourhoods, history, music, what to order). Say once that the usual places (wall.top_names) are great but everyone gets them. If status is needs_input, fix the input it names (e.g. a full title or a type) and call again. Takes ~1-25 s live.
